items.headline: Ja'Vin Simkins scores twice in 4th quarter and UAB defeats Charlotte 23-12
items.description: — Ja'Vin Simkins ran for two fourth-quarter touchdowns, Rod Robinson II ran for 101 yards and UAB defeated Charlotte 23-12 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Tulane rallies from 10-point deficit, beats Charlotte 38-31 in OT
items.description: — Johnnie Daniels had 99 yards rushing and two touchdowns, TJ Smith returned a kickoff 95 yards for a touchdown and Tulane rallied from a 10-point fourth-quarter deficit to beat Charlotte 38-31 in overtime on Friday night.
